purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 619 Gujrat (city code 7958); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.
primaryPublisher: District Gujrat administration; Punjab Land Records Authority and PULSE
registryBasis: Official District Gujrat sources identify a Gujrat Land Record Center, and Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) provides provincial land-record services. The official PULSE map offers a public-user path and a Parcels layer, with a disclaimer that displayed parcel lines are indicative; complete parcel details are login-gated. Anonymous ArcGIS metadata requests to the advertised parcel-related services returned Token Required, so no feature schema or geometry was retrieved.

officialSources.observation: Official District Gujrat page is titled “Inauguration of Land Record Center Gujrat”; direct web-page fetch timed out, so indexed page content is the available evidence.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describes digital land record and registration services across Punjab; used as jurisdictional context, not as citywide polygon coverage proof.

Official PULSE public map page (anonymous HTTPS GET 200) displays public-user mode, a Parcels layer, and a disclaimer that lines are indicative and not legal boundaries; complete parcel details are login-gated.
